import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for the invitation. # The placeholders will be replaced with escaped values. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes} """ def build_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, details_of_event: str, when_event_is: str, extra_event_info: str ) -> str: """ Build a secure HTML invitation from user supplied data. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or heading of the event. details_of_event : str A detailed description of the event. May contain line breaks or formatting. when_event_is : str The date of the event. extra_event_info : str Any additional instructions or notes from the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering. """ # Escape all user supplied data to prevent XSS or HTML injection safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(details_of_event, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(when_event_is, quote=True) # For extra info we allow line breaks but still escape the content safe_notes = html.escape(extra_event_info, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Insert the escaped values into the template invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
